entities.title: software-developers-toolbox
entities.summary: A collection of command-line tools for a developer's own machine, mostly macOS: four Rust crates, the zazzle C invoker, and the C# indexer zazzle-csharp-indexer.
entities.purpose: Holds the tools, the workflows that test and release them, and the agent skills and instructions for using them. The tools share a repository, a Cargo workspace and one release, not an architecture. Where one uses another, the code says so: the zazzle invoker is the client of the zazzled daemon and hands `zazzle free-disk-space` and `zazzle fix-network` to those binaries, and zazzled asks zazzle-csharp-indexer's daemon for the terse view of C# files. agent-fs, fix-network and free-disk-space call no other tool.
boundaries: Each tool is documented in its own folder: macos/rust/fix-network, macos/rust/free-disk-space, macos/rust/agent-fs, macos/rust/zazzled with macos/c/zazzle, and macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-indexer.
The Homebrew formula is not kept here: the release writes it into the external tap zazzcat/homebrew-z; macos/release documents how.
Meta/Agents/ is a copy of human-assisted-software-development's Agents/Skills and Agents/Knowledge. It is changed in that repository and copied here, and has no .dev folder.
The download site icelander.net/downloads, the GitHub releases and the tap are outside the repository; the release workflow publishes to them.
